parties: Akmon Wimalasiri Devasurendra v. Thamara Kumari Wijesundera Akmon Wimalasiri Devasurendra v. Thamara Kumari Wijesundera View More
keywords: Judgement and decree given in favour of the Appellant for specific performance of an agreement to sell was successfully appealed in this Court; Trial taken up de novo and District Judge dismissed Appellant\'s action on the preliminary objection of maintainability of the action as the agreement provided for payment of damages and not specific performance; Appellant appealed against the same. Held - Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Section 147 of the Civil Procedure Code
